title: feat: give pollinations-large 50 GiB free disk and add rclone to sandboxes
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: The pollinations-large sandbox template now requests 51 GB of free disk, up from 21 GB; the standard pollinations template remains at 21 GB. Both templates add rclone for mounting S3, R2, or GCS buckets as folders, so large files can outlive a sandbox. The Sandboxes docs now list the disk sizes and explain bucket mounting.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workshop, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and helps a single CRT monitor robot connect a large lime green (#ecf874) disk to a cloud-shaped storage bucket, with flowers and code-vines growing around them. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, in a cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic scene with soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, and retro gaming vibes.
